articles.summary: Fastenal Company (Nasdaq:FAST) ('Fastenal,' 'we,' 'our,' or 'us') announced the date and time for its conference call to review 2026 third quarter results, as well as current operations. The conference call will be broadcast live over the Internet on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. central time.
